sourceBodies.modelFHProvenance: Existing model estimate, not independently measured.

supportedFacts: The official garage photo shows an open multi-storey concrete parking structure with helix ramps, exterior deck spandrels and column openings. A single full-height filled interior is the wrong structural type.
The official parking page states the maximum garage vehicle height is6ft10in (2.0828m). This is an operational entrance limit, not a measured soffit height at every road point.

The official2026-11 ground transportation map explicitly depicts Level3 ground transportation/TNC and Level4 parking/skybridges. It gives no absolute elevations, slab thicknesses, column plan or georeferenced road-floor assignment.

The independent2012 Departures Drive photograph shows cars using an upper curved curb beneath the terminal canopy, with columns along the curb. It gives no independently calibrated canopy soffit height or exact current column coordinates.

Aerial overlay shows exact garage source road geometries on the source footprint and helix locations, and the terminal road beneath/along its roof projection. The aerial is top down and cannot establish internal floor heights or under-roof facade lines.
